title: Vulnerability Scanning and Remediation in AWS Cloud
objectives: Understand the importance of vulnerability scanning in AWS cloud security
Learn how to remediate common vulnerabilities using AWS services
Develop skills in configuring AWS Config and Amazon Inspector
prerequisites: Basic understanding of AWS cloud architecture and services
Familiarity with AWS CLI and SDKs
Knowledge of AWS IAM roles and permissions

mission_brief.briefing: Your team is responsible for securing the Aegis Logistics cloud environment. You have been tasked with identifying and remediating any vulnerabilities in the AWS infrastructure.
rules_of_engagement: Do not introduce new vulnerabilities or security risks to the environment
Ensure all actions are documented and justified
Collaborate with team members to ensure comprehensive coverage

content.concept: Vulnerability scanning is a critical component of AWS cloud security. It involves identifying potential weaknesses in the environment that could be exploited by attackers. In this lesson, you will learn how to configure and use AWS services such as Amazon Inspector and AWS Config to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
content.walkthrough: To begin, navigate to the AWS Management Console and select the AWS Config service. From there, create a new configuration recorder and specify the resources you want to monitor. Next, enable Amazon Inspector and define the scan types you want to run. Finally, review the findings and take remediation actions as necessary.
checkpoints: AWS Config is enabled and configured correctly
Amazon Inspector scans are running regularly
Vulnerabilities are being remediated in a timely manner
common_mistakes: Failing to configure AWS Config properly

lab.setup: Create an AWS account and enable the necessary services. Install the AWS CLI on your local machine.
steps: Navigate to the AWS Management Console and select AWS Config
Create a new configuration recorder and specify the resources you want to monitor
Enable Amazon Inspector and define the scan types you want to run
Run an Amazon Inspector scan and review the findings
Remediate any vulnerabilities identified by Amazon Inspector
safety: Do not make any changes to production environments without proper authorization
Ensure all actions are documented and justified
Collaborate with team members to ensure comprehensive coverage

elite_competence.scenario_name: Vulnerability Scanning and Remediation in AWS Cloud

bug_injection.description: A critical vulnerability has been introduced into the environment. The bug injection will simulate a real-world scenario where an attacker is attempting to exploit a known vulnerability.
bug_injection.bad_state: The environment has been compromised and sensitive data has been leaked.

success_criteria.expected_output: There are no users with elevated privileges

interrogation_questions: How would you configure AWS Config to monitor for vulnerabilities?
What steps would you take to remediate a critical vulnerability identified by Amazon Inspector?
How do you ensure that all actions taken during the lab are documented and justified?

accessibility.alt_text_summary: This lesson covers vulnerability scanning and remediation in AWS cloud security.

resume_bullets: Configured and enabled AWS Config and Amazon Inspector for vulnerability scanning
Remediated critical vulnerabilities identified by Amazon Inspector
Developed skills in configuring AWS services for security
